parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the disabled software tag. The description can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, spaces, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Chinese characters are supported. This parameter can be left empty.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the disabled software tag. Fuzzy match is supported. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Chinese characters are supported. Spaces are not supported.
